{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify the row with max sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Define sentinel value
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is the sentinel value
valid_severe = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients using only valid values
mean_biomarker_valid = valid_severe['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f'Number of valid severe patients (excluding sentinel values): {len(valid_severe)}')
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) for severe patients (valid only): {mean_biomarker_valid}')"}
